description: Persistent, user-level local inference router on loopback port 18080. Started by Start-Shell.ps1 (or autostart) outside the shell; the shell attaches to it and never stops it.

service.start_hint: Started outside the shell: Start-Shell.ps1 starts it when llama.cpp/FreeToken is the selected backend, or run modules\sovereign\Start-LlamaCppSupervisor.ps1
service.stop_hint: Persists after the shell exits by design. Stop it with modules\sovereign\Stop-LlamaCppSupervisor.ps1
